python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, hashlib, re
from collections import Counter
root=pathlib.Path('docs/workstreams/research/AF-RES-004')
expected_blobs={
  "PROTOCOL.md": "514ae9b961a9e16229ec3a0c4d1b72f635424496",
  "CASES.json": "ed8ca0252a331830ecf44329a18d0eb77182cc72",
  "EXPECTED.json": "4737e0ff286199912ef4d450af2d3187568fbf21",
  "sources.json": "0fcefbaba8fe854b672aeeb731bd3958d4bbcfb5",
  "methodology-notes.json": "91cb5cf7ca28eaf8c0bdd637da57ff0315c7551e",
  "source-pins.json": "7e5077d2f071d42a53a81e74a7c91348a7d24723",
  "blind-review-a.json": "b0d0e6b880e76dfe5eeb208ae5a595ea85310800",
  "blind-review-b.json": "6bd533665b0ab08280997ac895ba667e1811809e",
  "revision-review.json": "796f6d3956bdee1f07e6d60cc8ad67f2111d5b31",
  "RESEARCH.md": "b38a3ed7926581eab6e156f00626fa58775965f3",
  "REVIEW.md": "6c58cb7849dbb412609172150ee6139f4651850d"
}
def git_blob(b):
    return hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()
normalized=[]
files=[]
for name, expected in expected_blobs.items():
    path=root/name
    original=path.read_bytes()
    candidates=[original]
    short=original
    for _ in range(3):
        if short.endswith(b'\n'):
            short=short[:-1]
            candidates.append(short)
    candidates.extend([original+b'\n',original+b'\n\n'])
    matches=[b for b in candidates if git_blob(b)==expected]
    assert matches, ('remote blob mismatch',name,git_blob(original),expected)
    chosen=matches[0]
    if chosen!=original:
        assert chosen.rstrip(b'\n')==original.rstrip(b'\n')
        path.write_bytes(chosen)
        normalized.append(name)
    files.append({'name':name,'bytes':len(chosen),'git_blob_sha':git_blob(chosen),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(chosen).hexdigest(),'remote_exact_match':True})
objs={p.name:json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in root.glob('*.json')}
c=objs['CASES.json']; e=objs['EXPECTED.json']; s=objs['sources.json']; m=objs['methodology-notes.json']; pins=objs['source-pins.json']
assert c['pack_version']==e['pack_version']=='1.2'
assert len(c['problems'])==4 and len(c['rows'])==18 and len(e['rows'])==18
row_ids=[r['row_id'] for r in c['rows']]
assert len(set(row_ids))==18
assert set(row_ids)=={r['row_id'] for r in e['rows']}
source_ids={x['id'] for x in s['sources']}
assert len(source_ids)==s['source_count']==27
assert source_ids=={x['id'] for x in c['source_catalog']}
assert all(set(r['source_ids'])<=source_ids for r in c['rows'])
for x in s['sources']:
    assert all(x.get(k) for k in ['url','checked_date_utc','read_scope','confirmed','limits'])
assert len(m['sources'])==6 and len({x['id'] for x in m['sources']})==6
for x in m['sources']:
    assert all(x.get(k) for k in ['url','read_scope','verified','limits'])
assert len(pins['pins'])==10 and len({x['id'] for x in pins['pins']})==10
assert all(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',x['commit_sha']) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',x['git_blob_sha']) for x in pins['pins'])
problem_ids={x['id'] for x in c['problems']} | {x['id'] for x in c['controlled_variants']}
assert all(r['problem_id'] in problem_ids for r in c['rows'])
req_ids={h['id'] for p in c['problems'] for h in p['hard_requirements']}
labels={'DIRECT_DOCUMENTED','CONDITIONAL_TRANSFER','SURFACE_OR_CONSTRAINT_MISMATCH','INSUFFICIENT'}
for r in e['rows']:
    assert r['label'] in labels
    assert all(h['id'] in req_ids and h['status'] in {'pass','fail','unknown','not_in_scope'} for h in r['H'])
    assert all(set(h['source_ids'])<=source_ids for h in r['H'])
    assert r['runtime_observation']=='not_performed'
    assert r['H_assessment_scope'] in {'reference_design','proposed_configuration'}
for who, name, orderkey in [('A','blind-review-a.json','assessment_order'),('B','blind-review-b.json','evaluation_order')]:
    review=objs[name]
    actual=[r['row_id'] for r in review['rows']]
    assert len(actual)==18 and len(set(actual))==18 and set(actual)==set(row_ids)
    assert actual==review[orderkey]==c['suggested_blind_orders'][who]
    assert all(all(k in r for k in ['row_id','label','role','L','E','H','T','source_locations','rationale','transfer_conditions','counterexample','minimum_next_check']) for r in review['rows'])
rev=objs['revision-review.json']
assert rev['review_type']=='NON_BLIND_REVISION_REVIEW'
assert any(x['id']=='REV-B-07' and x['status']=='remaining_disagreement' for x in rev['findings'])
assert Counter(r['label'] for r in e['rows'])==e['expected_counts']
assert sorted(p.name for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name not in {'VERIFICATION.json','HANDOFF.md'})==sorted(expected_blobs)
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','check_kind':'artifact_integrity_and_committed_bytes_only','problems':4,'rows':18,'expected_rows':18,'primary_source_records':27,'methodology_source_records':6,'total_distinct_sources':33,'immutable_document_pins':10,'original_blind_reviews':2,'original_blind_rows_each':18,'json_files_parsed':len(objs),'artifact_files_checked':len(files),'terminal_lf_normalized_to_committed_bytes':normalized,'files':files,'not_checked':['candidate_runtime','software_integration','semantic_truth_by_automation','repository_wide_tests','human_utility']},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
